title: CB Libs
headline: CB Libs Has Been Updated!
description: A new update is now available for CB Libs.
changes: Limited built-in framework and inventory support to RSG and VORP
Limited all framework detection, adapters, notifications, lifecycle handlers, and inventory code to RSG and VORP
Verified and corrected VORP item queries, capacity checks, item mutations, and usable-item registration
Added VORP custom-inventory registration before opening shared stashes
Added a generic prison handoff API with automatic rsg-prison support and an optional callback for any other prison resource
Kept framework-independent notifications, player data, money, inventory, prompts, and target interactions
